newsitem.title: GREECE: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS- JUNE 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS- JUNE 23.

text.p: Leading stories in the Greek general press:
--Greek underworld figures are involved in the trade in drug and arms originating from Albania and operating over the narrow sea separating Albania from the holiday island of Corfu.
--Andreas Papandreou, the late founder and president of ruling PASOK, was the focus of memorial events yesterday at the Athens First Cemetery and the Athens Concert Hall.
--The financial crimes squad, SDOE, has set its sights on doctors and clinics as the first step to combatting tax evasion in the health sector.
--Tension at yesterday's memorial service for Papandreou as hecklers shouted at members of the government arriving at the Athens First Cemetery.
--The government has reportedly developed a way to solve the problem of public enterprises and organisations' deficits by instituting different rates and tariffs for different income brackets.

--Papandreou's daughter Sophia yesterday lashed out at hecklers targetting her husband and at the exploitation of her father by his third wife Dimitra Liani. --Maria Petrakis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
